widgets_values: Use the first input image as the equally divided 3 by 3 grid, generate black and white hand-sketched storyboards within each box, with simple scribble lines and no complicated details. Consistent style across all frames. Use the second input image as reference to aid the storyboard. Leave the box blank if it has less than nine shots. Storyboard is as following:

Shot1 - A spotless retro-futuristic kitchen emerges from a soft fade. Curved cabinetry, chrome appliances with rounded edges, warm cream and sage tones. A bag of Comfy coffee sits on the counter, logo facing camera.

Shot2 - A hand scoop whole Arabica beans from the Comfy bag into a sleek retro grinder, in an unhurried motion. The beans are rich and glossy.

Shot3 - Dark espresso blooms into a rounded and matte ceramic cup. Steam curls upward against the clean kitchen backdrop.

Shot4 - Person holds the cup in both hands, standing at a large curved kitchen window. Soft morning light spills in. Eyes close briefly in comfort.

Shot5 - Hard cut to a clean studio card: the Comfy coffee bag centered on a tabletop. Logo fades in last. Hold.

Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.
